title: Hardening weight-only INT8 profile pipeline with chaos validation and golden prompts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Improve robustness and observability of the weight-only INT8 profile generation and deployment pipeline (GPTQ/AWQ paths). Scope includes: pipeline hardening, deterministic calibration snapshotting, expanded golden prompt set for accuracy regression detection, chaos tests for KV cache/batching interactions, and canary orchestration templates for rollback-safe rollouts. We need to ensure cross-hardware reproducibility and provide clear mitigations for quantization-induced regressions.
tasks: Add deterministic seed capture and profile metadata to calibration artifacts (layer scaling, zero-points, per-channel stats)
Implement shadow-run mode: compute INT8 outputs in parallel with FP32 on sample traffic and log divergence metrics to Console (token-level diffs, perplexity delta)
Design and add 3 new golden prompt categories: instruction-following, factual QA, and long-context summarization; store canonical references and expected tolerances
Create chaos harness for KV cache eviction and non-ideal batching (latency spikes, partial requests) and run nightly against a representative model matrix
Expand regression gate to include cost-per-token delta and tail-latency thresholds in addition to accuracy thresholds
Create canary playbook with automated rollback criteria and safe-fallback to FP32/dense variant when drift exceeds tolerance
acceptance_criteria: Calibration artifacts include deterministic metadata and are traceable to a snapshot ID and commit SHA
Nightly shadow-run reports show <0.8% median token-level divergence and no more than 2% of prompts exceed configured tolerance for any model in the canary set
Chaos runs produce reproducible failure traces and we have at least two automated mitigations (fallback model variant, reduced batching) implemented
Canary pipeline can automatically rollback within 5 minutes of breach detection and emits an incident with root-cause template populated
Dashboard in Console surfaces per-prompt drift, per-layer quantization stats, and historical trend charts for at least 30 days

release_notes: Add deterministic calibration metadata, shadow-run telemetry, golden prompt suite, chaos harness for KV cache, and automated canary rollback policy for INT8 weight-only profiles.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on: deterministic snapshot schema, telemetry PII safety, and canary rollback thresholds. If QA finds >2% regression on any golden prompt category, block merge until mitigation validated.
risk_assessment: Medium: changes touch calibration pipeline and telemetry. Primary risk is false positive regressions from noisy prompts; mitigations include multiple prompt categories and shadow-run before rollout.
